# Bug-fix ledger

_Auto-generated by `bugfix_ledger` from the live `FIXED BUG` / `J2X-BUGFIX` markers in the converter's authored sources. Do not edit by hand -- fix the marker in-code and re-run the converter (or `codebreaker java bugfix-ledger`) to regenerate._

Every game-breaking fix carries a greppable in-code marker (standing rule). This ledger is the index of those markers so a fix can never be silently reverted by a reconvert without it showing up here as missing.

**12 markers across 12 distinct fixes.**
